compliant.outcome: More new customers complete their first data import after signing up, by improving where the existing signup, email and import step lose them.

The signup flow hands a new customer straight into the import
The share of new customers who complete a first import can be read from the existing report
failure: New customers still stall at the import step
The change breaks the existing signup or welcome email

compliant.reply: I read this as getting more new customers through their first import. I will start with the import step and the usage report, change what loses people, and check the first-import rate afterwards.
